_hinweis: Soundeffekt-Bibliothek für alle VoxCRM-Filme. Erzeugen: node ../engine/ton-effekte.mjs (nur fehlende). anker: wo der Kontakt im Klang liegt – 'start' (Kontakt am Anfang), 'spitze' (lauteste Stelle = Kontakt, automatisch gemessen), 'ende' (Klang endet auf dem Kontakt, z. B. Riser).

klick.text: Single crisp premium trackpad click, very short and clean, tight, no reverb, no room

tick.text: Tiny soft digital UI tick, very short subtle high blip, clean, no reverb

pop.text: Soft gentle bubbly UI pop for an interface card element appearing, short, clean, premium app sound

tippen.text: Quiet fast typing on a premium laptop keyboard, about eight soft keystrokes, close and clean, no room

whoosh.text: Smooth fast airy whoosh transition for motion graphics, modern and clean, short tail, no hiss

swish.text: Short soft subtle swish, quick UI swipe of air, light and clean

riser.text: Short airy synth riser swelling up with tension, cinematic but subtle, stops right at the peak

revcym.text: Reverse cymbal swell, airy and bright, ends sharply

impact.text: Deep soft cinematic sub boom hit, clean and premium, short natural tail

thump.text: Punchy tight low thud for kinetic typography word slam, short and clean

flut.text: Liquid fill transition: deep soft whoosh swelling into a warm low impact, premium cinematic

slot.text: Digital counter reel spinning, rapid clicking ticks that slow down and stop, slot machine numbers, clean

chime.text: Elegant soft success chime, single gentle bell ding, premium UI confirmation sound

push.text: Modern smartphone notification sound, soft two-note chime, clean and friendly

funken.text: Tiny magical sparkle shimmer, short glittery twinkle, subtle and light

falten.text: Crisp sheet of paper being folded once, quick paper fold

papier.text: Sheet of paper sliding onto a desk, soft paper swoosh

logo.text: Premium brand logo reveal: warm deep boom with a shimmering elegant synth sparkle tail, Apple keynote style, clean
